items.title: Listening first
items.text: Every conversation begins with listening. You share as much or as little as you like.

items.title: From wherever you are
items.text: Sessions are online, over Google Meet, at a time you agree together.

items.title: No forms about your life
items.text: You never have to explain your situation in a form.

items.title: Plain about money
items.text: Fees are discussed directly, and paid by UPI against an invoice.

forWhom.title: Who it is for
forWhom.text: People of every background, faith and identity, including queer and trans people, who will always be met with respect. [Sarvakali’s own words here.]
